name: app-store-compliance
description: Avoid common App Store and Google Play rejections. Open playbook and pre-submission guard with 124 documented rejection patterns and fixes, privacy manifest and Data safety checks, 112 tracked deadlines (EU AI Act, DSA, COPPA, age laws), and a skill for AI coding agents.
one_liner: A checklist-and-scanner combo that catches the most common reasons Apple or Google reject an app before you waste a submission cycle finding out the hard way.
buyer: A solo indie app developer or a small app-dev agency who has been burned by an App Store rejection right before a launch deadline.
business_use_cases: An indie-app consultancy offers a paid 'pre-submission compliance audit' as the last step before every client launches, catching rejections before Apple does.
A small app agency bundles a compliance check into its standard build retainer as a value-add upsell, reducing costly last-minute rework.
A compliance-focused freelancer tracks regulatory deadlines (EU AI Act, COPPA, DSA) for several app clients at once and bills a flat monthly fee to keep them off the radar.

money_ideas.idea: Flat-fee pre-submission compliance audit charged per app launch
Monthly compliance-monitoring retainer tracking multiple apps' deadlines and policy changes

steal_this: Offer a $200 'will Apple reject this?' audit to indie developers in app-dev communities this week, using the playbook as your checklist.
